statement: The proportion of SUID cases with substance/toxin exposure increased from 2004 to 2019.
rationale: This design tracks trends within SUID cases exposed to substances/toxins over time using ncfrp_v51. However, it cannot provide incidence or adjust for confounders effectively without additional denominator data.
prior_art: The closest tested work is C10 from the SUID manuscript and C24 from the bedsharing manuscript, which address trends but not substance/toxin exposure specifically. The question remains open as no prior study has examined this trend over time.
cannot_establish: incidence or rates of SUID cases exposed to substances/toxins, causal relationships between substance/toxin exposure and SUID.
